messages.subject: error when running Maaslin demo in R
messages.subject_clean: error when running Maaslin demo in R
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I have installed all required R-packages for maaslin and tried to run the demo:
InputTSV <- system.file('extdata','maaslin_demo2.tsv', package="Maaslin")
InputConfig <-system.file('extdata','maaslin_demo2.read.config', package="Maaslin")
Maaslin(InputTSV,'maaslin_example_output',strInputConfig=InputConfig)

I get the following error:
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Running quality control.
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Removing the following for data lower bound.
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Bacteria
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Number of features transformed =  0
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Grubbs Test::Removing 1 outliers from Bacteria|Bacteroidetes|Bacteroidia|Bacteroidales|Bacteroidaceae|Bacteroides|101
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Sample7
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Grubbs Test::Removing 1 outliers from Bacteria|Firmicutes|Clostridia|Clostridiales|Lachnospiraceae
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Sample8
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Grubbs Test::Removing 1 outliers from Bacteria|Proteobacteria|Betaproteobacteria|Burkholderiales|Alcaligenaceae|Parasutterella|1344
2017-08-10 09:41:57 INFO:maaslin:Sample5
Error in if (0 < (resp <- attr(attr(frame, "terms"), "response"))) { :
  argument is of length zero
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In which(is.na <http://is.na>(as.numeric(lItemElement))) : NAs introduced by coercion
2: In which(is.na <http://is.na>(as.numeric(lItemElement))) : NAs introduced by coercion

How can I fix this?
Kind regards,
Stefanie
